title: Restriction at a fixed coordinate
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $J\\subseteq\\{0,\\ldots,n-1\\}$, and assign a sign in $\\{1,-1\\}$ to each coordinate outside $J$. At any coordinate $i\\notin J$, the determined coordinate restriction fixes the coordinate to $1$ when its assigned sign is $1$, and to $-1$ otherwise.
